# @tansy/subscriptions

Runs subscriptions from one section of the dashboard: plans, what they open, gating collections, and who's on which plan. Built on @tansy/payments.

```bash
npm install @tansy/subscriptions
```

Add it to `tansy.config.ts`. See [the subscriptions plugin documentation](https://github.com/mhmdsalahsebai/tansy/blob/main/docs/plugins/subscriptions.md) for what it adds and the options it takes.

A first-party plugin for [tansy](https://github.com/mhmdsalahsebai/tansy), a self-hosted, runtime-schema CMS for Next.js. MIT licensed.
